query.description: Extracts formal-run completion, artifact coverage, the complete GPT active-pass rate, and paired-axis interaction.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM document, json_each(body, '$.final_matrix.runs') WHERE json_extract(value, '$.result_status') = 'complete') AS complete_formal_runs, json_extract(body, '$.final_matrix.aggregate_artifact_status.result_records') * 1.0 / json_extract(body, '$.final_matrix.aggregate_artifact_status.planned') AS final_result_coverage, json_extract(body, '$.final_matrix.runs[0].active_pass_rate_evaluated_pct') / 100.0 AS gpt_active_pass_rate, json_extract(body, '$.final_matrix.gpt_complete.difference_in_differences_pp') AS gpt_did_pp FROM document;
filters: Persisted results/*.result.json sidecars only; resume JSONL files are not episodes.
metric_definitions: Final result coverage = persisted final-matrix result sidecars / 1,600 planned episodes.
Active pass = protocol-valid completion and deterministic held-out scientific success.
Delta is expressed in percentage points.

query.description: Extracts completion, pass, protocol, and failure counts for the four formal Player runs.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body), items AS (SELECT value FROM document, json_each(body, '$.final_matrix.runs')) SELECT json_extract(value, '$.model') AS model, json_extract(value, '$.result_status') AS result_status, json_extract(value, '$.planned') AS planned, json_extract(value, '$.result_records') AS result_records, json_extract(value, '$.coverage_pct') AS coverage_pct, json_extract(value, '$.evaluated') AS evaluated, json_extract(value, '$.infrastructure_failed') AS infrastructure_failed, json_extract(value, '$.unattempted_or_not_durable') AS unattempted_or_not_durable, json_extract(value, '$.active_pass') AS active_pass, json_extract(value, '$.active_pass_rate_evaluated_pct') AS active_pass_rate_pct, json_extract(value, '$.protocol_completion_rate_evaluated_pct') AS protocol_completion_rate_pct, json_extract(value, '$.conditional_scientific_pass_pct') AS conditional_scientific_pass_pct, json_extract(value, '$.scientific_failure') AS scientific_failure, json_extract(value, '$.player_generation_failure') AS player_generation_failure, json_extract(value, '$.player_protocol_failure') AS player_protocol_failure, json_extract(value, '$.median_elapsed_seconds') AS median_elapsed_seconds FROM items ORDER BY coverage_pct DESC;
filters: Persisted results/*.result.json sidecars only; resume JSONL files are not episodes.

query.description: Extracts outcomes on the 35 episode IDs evaluated by all four formal Player runs.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body), items AS (SELECT value FROM document, json_each(body, '$.final_matrix.common_evaluated_subset.runs')) SELECT json_extract(value, '$.model') AS model, json_extract(value, '$.n') AS n, json_extract(value, '$.active_pass') AS active_pass, json_extract(value, '$.active_pass_rate_pct') AS active_pass_rate_pct, json_extract(value, '$.protocol_completion_rate_pct') AS protocol_completion_rate_pct, json_extract(value, '$.scientifically_evaluable') AS scientifically_evaluable, json_extract(value, '$.conditional_scientific_pass_pct') AS conditional_scientific_pass_pct, json_extract(value, '$.scientific_failure') AS scientific_failure, json_extract(value, '$.player_generation_failure') AS player_generation_failure, json_extract(value, '$.player_protocol_failure') AS player_protocol_failure FROM items ORDER BY active_pass_rate_pct DESC;
filters: Persisted results/*.result.json sidecars only; resume JSONL files are not episodes.

query.description: Extracts the balanced Historical/Counterfactual × Identification/Discovery outcomes for the complete GPT run.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body), items AS (SELECT value FROM document, json_each(body, '$.final_matrix.gpt_complete.cells')) SELECT json_extract(value, '$.cell') AS cell, json_extract(value, '$.world') AS world, json_extract(value, '$.track') AS track, json_extract(value, '$.n') AS n, json_extract(value, '$.active_pass') AS active_pass, json_extract(value, '$.active_pass_rate_pct') AS active_pass_rate_pct, json_extract(value, '$.protocol_completion_rate_pct') AS protocol_completion_rate_pct, json_extract(value, '$.scientifically_evaluable') AS scientifically_evaluable, json_extract(value, '$.conditional_scientific_pass_pct') AS conditional_scientific_pass_pct FROM items;
filters: Persisted results/*.result.json sidecars only; resume JSONL files are not episodes.

query.description: Extracts the 20 family-level difference-in-differences values and four cell rates.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body), items AS (SELECT value FROM document, json_each(body, '$.final_matrix.gpt_complete.family_difference_in_differences.rows')) SELECT json_extract(value, '$.family') AS family, json_extract(value, '$.delta_pp') AS delta_pp, json_extract(value, '$.historical_identification_pct') AS historical_identification_pct, json_extract(value, '$.historical_discovery_pct') AS historical_discovery_pct, json_extract(value, '$.counterfactual_identification_pct') AS counterfactual_identification_pct, json_extract(value, '$.counterfactual_discovery_pct') AS counterfactual_discovery_pct FROM items ORDER BY delta_pp DESC, family;
filters: Persisted results/*.result.json sidecars only; resume JSONL files are not episodes.

query.description: Combines terminal failure codes with the first localized process misstep for 820 evaluated formal episodes.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body), terminal AS (SELECT json_extract(value, '$.code') AS code, json_extract(value, '$.episodes') AS n FROM document, json_each(body, '$.failure_modes.final_matrix_terminal')), first_step AS (SELECT json_extract(value, '$.code') AS code, json_extract(value, '$.episodes') AS n FROM document, json_each(body, '$.failure_modes.final_matrix_first_misstep')), codes AS (SELECT code FROM terminal UNION SELECT code FROM first_step) SELECT codes.code, coalesce(terminal.n, 0) AS terminal_episodes, coalesce(first_step.n, 0) AS first_misstep_episodes FROM codes LEFT JOIN terminal USING (code) LEFT JOIN first_step USING (code) ORDER BY terminal_episodes + first_misstep_episodes DESC, codes.code;
filters: Persisted results/*.result.json sidecars only; resume JSONL files are not episodes.

query.description: Extracts three non-comparable pilot/warmup summaries without pooling them.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body) SELECT 'DeepSeek 20-family / 1 repeat' AS run, json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_20_family_80.summary.result_records') AS n, json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_20_family_80.summary.active_pass') AS pass, json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_20_family_80.summary.active_pass_rate_evaluated_pct') AS all_denominator_pass_pct, json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_20_family_80.summary.conditional_scientific_pass_pct') AS conditional_pass_pct FROM document UNION ALL SELECT 'DeepSeek legacy 58', json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_legacy_58.summary.result_records'), json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_legacy_58.summary.active_pass'), json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_legacy_58.summary.active_pass_rate_evaluated_pct'), json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_legacy_58.summary.conditional_scientific_pass_pct') FROM document UNION ALL SELECT 'Pendulum warmup v3', json_extract(body, '$.pilots.pendulum_warmup_60.summary.result_records'), json_extract(body, '$.pilots.pendulum_warmup_60.summary.evaluation_success'), json_extract(body, '$.pilots.pendulum_warmup_60.summary.evaluation_success') * 100.0 / 60.0, json_extract(body, '$.pilots.pendulum_warmup_60.conditional_pass_pct') FROM document;
filters: Persisted results/*.result.json sidecars only; resume JSONL files are not episodes.

query.description: Extracts all 27 direct out/runs subdirectories and their canonical artifact counts.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body), items AS (SELECT value FROM document, json_each(body, '$.run_inventory')) SELECT json_extract(value, '$.run') AS run, json_extract(value, '$.classification') AS classification, json_extract(value, '$.planned') AS planned, json_extract(value, '$.result_records') AS result_records, json_extract(value, '$.evaluated') AS evaluated, json_extract(value, '$.legacy_completed') AS legacy_completed, json_extract(value, '$.infrastructure_failed') AS infrastructure_failed, json_extract(value, '$.active_pass') AS active_pass, json_extract(value, '$.evaluation_success') AS evaluation_success, json_extract(value, '$.raw_jsonl') AS raw_jsonl, json_extract(value, '$.resume_jsonl') AS resume_jsonl, json_extract(value, '$.note') AS note FROM items ORDER BY classification, run;
filters: Persisted results/*.result.json sidecars only; resume JSONL files are not episodes.

blocks.body: # Role Benchmark 本地运行结果汇总

## 结论：目前只有一个完整正式矩阵，差异化信号存在但还不能做四模型正式排名

- **可用主结果只有 GPT-5.6 Sol 的完整 400 episodes。** 它取得 223/400 active pass（55.75%），371/400 protocol completion（92.75%），提交后的条件科学通过率为 60.11%。
- **paired-axis 信号在该完整 run 上清楚。** H/I、H/D、C/I、C/D 分别为 66%、75%、50%、32%，所以预设 Δ 为 +27 pp；20 个 family 中 15 个为正，family-level 平均同为 +27 pp，描述性 95% t 区间为 +11.43 至 +42.57 pp。
- **其余三个正式模型没有跑完。** Claude 保存 351/400、Kimi 36/400、Qwen 36/400；四者共同可比的只有相同 35 episodes，结果只能视为 pilot。
- **这批结果不是当前最新三角色 API 管线的正式输出。** 四个 final run 使用 deterministic case Oracle 和规则 held-out evaluator，没有 LLM judge artifact；全部 652 个已提交 final 仍含后来删除的 `FinalSubmission.confidence`。

## 四模型计划只完成了 823/1,600 个持久化结果

GPT 跑满 400；Claude、Kimi、Qwen 分别在基础设施错误后停止。四个目录合计有 820 个 evaluated、3 个 infrastructure failed，另有 777 个计划 episode 没有本地持久化结果。因此不能用各目录当前 observed pass rate 直接排列四模型。

## 同题比较的 35 episodes 只给出初步顺序

在四个模型都完成的相同 schedule 1–35 上，Claude、GPT、Kimi、Qwen 的 active-pass rate 分别为 65.71%、54.29%、40.00%、25.71%。失败组成差异很大：Claude 的主要损失来自 generation/protocol，GPT 则主要是提交后的科学失败。该子集只含 repeat 1 的随机前缀，四格样本为 H/I=6、H/D=10、C/I=11、C/D=8，不能替代完整 matched matrix。

## GPT 的 counterfactual penalty 在 Discovery 轨明显放大

Historical 相对 Counterfactual 的差距在 Identification 是 16 pp（66%−50%），在 Discovery 是 43 pp（75%−32%），所以 Δ=(H,D−C,D)−(H,I−C,I)=+27 pp。四格 protocol completion 均在 92%–94%，说明该差异主要来自科学评分，而不是某一格更容易触发协议失败。

## +27 pp 不是由单个 family 独占，但 family 间异质性很大

把 family 作为统计独立单位，15/20 的 Δ 为正、2 个为零、3 个为负；均值 +27 pp，中位数 +20 pp，描述性 95% t 区间为 +11.43 至 +42.57 pp。这个结果为 matched-axis 差异化命题提供单模型支持，但仍需要其他完整 Player run 复现，且不能把 5 次 repeat 当作 100 个独立 family。

## 失败既包括科学错误，也包括旧协议与 action generation 错误

820 个 evaluated 正式 episodes 中有 457 pass、195 scientific failure、124 player generation failure、44 player protocol failure。Terminal failure 以 held-out prediction error（187）最多；failure analyzer 还把 32 个 episode 的第一处错误定位为 final model misses observed evidence、19 个定位为 belief update opposes evidence、18 个定位为 belief update omitted。与此同时，33 个 terminal failure 来自后来已删除的 final-confidence mismatch，因此这部分不应被当作当前协议下的模型能力失败。

## DeepSeek 与 pendulum 结果只能作为各自 pilot 解读

DeepSeek 20-family 单 repeat 为 21/80 active pass（26.25%，提交后 42.00%）；旧 58-case 为 23/58（39.66%）；pendulum v3 旧 schema 为 33/60 evaluation success（55.00%，completed 后 84.62%）。它们的 Oracle、cell 平衡或 schema 不同，不能与 final 四模型池化。

## 统计口径

- **Episode 单位**：一个已持久化的 `results/*.result.json`；35 个 `.resume-N.jsonl` 是同一 episode 的重试，不重复计数。
- **Active pass**：Player 完成协议且规则 evaluator 的 held-out scientific evaluation 成功。
- **条件科学通过率**：active pass / scientifically evaluable，即只在具有严格可解码 final model 的 episodes 上计算。
- **H/C/I/D**：Historical、Counterfactual、Identification、Discovery。
- **Difference-in-differences**：Δ=(P_H,D−P_C,D)−(P_H,I−P_C,I)；正值表示 historical advantage 在 Discovery 轨更大。

## 复算与验证方法

枚举了 `out/runs` 的 27 个直接子目录，其中 25 个是 bench-like，2 个是 temporal census/pipeline 输出。所有跨 case 汇总只使用布尔 active-pass、protocol-completion 和 scientific-evaluable 字段；没有平均不同 family 的专用误差分数。四模型比较取 evaluated episode ID 的交集；主 Δ 在完整 GPT run 上先按四格计算，再以 20 个 family 的 Δ 作为独立单位复核。SQLite 查询结果与两条独立脚本复算一致。

## 局限与版本边界

1. **只有 GPT 完整。** 另外三个模型的 observed rows 是同一随机 schedule 的前缀，缺失不是随机完成后的普通 sampling noise。
2. **结果来自旧 submission contract。** 四个 final run 的 652 个已提交记录都含现在已经删除的 `FinalSubmission.confidence`，并有 33 个 terminal final-confidence mismatch。
3. **没有 LLM evaluator 结果。** `evaluator` 配置为空，也没有 `evaluations/*.evaluation.json`；现有 active pass 来自规则 held-out evaluator。
4. **Oracle 条件不同。** 四个 final run 使用 deterministic `case_world_model`，DeepSeek 80-run 使用 LLM presentation over authoritative world model。
5. **Claude 目录是混合快照。** `episodes.json` 声明 351 但数组有 356 条，后 5 条没有完整本地 sidecars；本报告只采信 351 个持久化 result 文件。
6. **Active pass 偏向完整可执行预测。** 如果项目要主测关系发现，应在未来 run 前把 structured relation recovery 注册为独立 endpoint，而不是继续依赖少量 post-hoc probes。

## 目录全量盘点

本地共有 1,110 个 result sidecars 和 1,149 个 JSONL；这些数字包含 superseded warmup、gateway/API 诊断和不同设计的 pilot，因此只用于说明存量，不构成一个统计总体。下表给出逐目录归类。

## 下一步：先让当前协议产生一组可比较的新结果

1. 用当前已删除 final confidence、允许单 hypothesis 收敛、严格可解码即科学评分的协议，重新跑至少一个完整 20-family × 4-cell × 5-repeat matrix。
2. Player、Oracle、Evaluator 的 provider/model 参数独立写入每个 run config；机器 held-out score 保留为主科学分数，LLM judge 只作为过程评分的独立层。
3. 若关系恢复是目标能力，将 direction/shape 或结构化 law relation 变成预先声明的提交与评分字段，再启动多模型正式比较。

## 仍需固定的评测选择

- 正式 primary endpoint 是完整 held-out prediction，还是结构化 relationship recovery？二者应分开报告，不能事后互换。
- 正式 Oracle 是否统一为 deterministic world model，LLM 只负责自然语言呈现？若不同 Player 使用不同 Oracle transport，模型间比较会混入 Oracle 方差。
- LLM judge 是否只量化 evidence use、belief update 与最终解释，并明确不覆盖机器可判定的科学真值分数？

query.description: Combines terminal failure codes with the first localized process misstep for 820 evaluated formal episodes.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body), terminal AS (SELECT json_extract(value, '$.code') AS code, json_extract(value, '$.episodes') AS n FROM document, json_each(body, '$.failure_modes.final_matrix_terminal')), first_step AS (SELECT json_extract(value, '$.code') AS code, json_extract(value, '$.episodes') AS n FROM document, json_each(body, '$.failure_modes.final_matrix_first_misstep')), codes AS (SELECT code FROM terminal UNION SELECT code FROM first_step) SELECT codes.code, coalesce(terminal.n, 0) AS terminal_episodes, coalesce(first_step.n, 0) AS first_misstep_episodes FROM codes LEFT JOIN terminal USING (code) LEFT JOIN first_step USING (code) ORDER BY terminal_episodes + first_misstep_episodes DESC, codes.code;

query.description: Extracts three non-comparable pilot/warmup summaries without pooling them.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body) SELECT 'DeepSeek 20-family / 1 repeat' AS run, json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_20_family_80.summary.result_records') AS n, json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_20_family_80.summary.active_pass') AS pass, json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_20_family_80.summary.active_pass_rate_evaluated_pct') AS all_denominator_pass_pct, json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_20_family_80.summary.conditional_scientific_pass_pct') AS conditional_pass_pct FROM document UNION ALL SELECT 'DeepSeek legacy 58', json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_legacy_58.summary.result_records'), json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_legacy_58.summary.active_pass'), json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_legacy_58.summary.active_pass_rate_evaluated_pct'), json_extract(body, '$.pilots.deepseek_legacy_58.summary.conditional_scientific_pass_pct') FROM document UNION ALL SELECT 'Pendulum warmup v3', json_extract(body, '$.pilots.pendulum_warmup_60.summary.result_records'), json_extract(body, '$.pilots.pendulum_warmup_60.summary.evaluation_success'), json_extract(body, '$.pilots.pendulum_warmup_60.summary.evaluation_success') * 100.0 / 60.0, json_extract(body, '$.pilots.pendulum_warmup_60.conditional_pass_pct') FROM document;

query.description: Extracts all 27 direct out/runs subdirectories and their canonical artifact counts.
query.sql: WITH document AS (SELECT CAST(readfile('out/bench_results_summary_20260830/summary.json') AS TEXT) AS body), items AS (SELECT value FROM document, json_each(body, '$.run_inventory')) SELECT json_extract(value, '$.run') AS run, json_extract(value, '$.classification') AS classification, json_extract(value, '$.planned') AS planned, json_extract(value, '$.result_records') AS result_records, json_extract(value, '$.evaluated') AS evaluated, json_extract(value, '$.legacy_completed') AS legacy_completed, json_extract(value, '$.infrastructure_failed') AS infrastructure_failed, json_extract(value, '$.active_pass') AS active_pass, json_extract(value, '$.evaluation_success') AS evaluation_success, json_extract(value, '$.raw_jsonl') AS raw_jsonl, json_extract(value, '$.resume_jsonl') AS resume_jsonl, json_extract(value, '$.note') AS note FROM items ORDER BY classification, run;
